name: Realtor Bot
author: Brantley
summary: Searches public property portals, builds shortlists, watches changes, and drafts tour requests for your approval.

usageNote: This is not a licensed real-estate service. Verify prices, taxes, flood risk, schools, and legal details with qualified sources.
